newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Sapura plans to buy UMW - Anwar.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Sapura plans to buy UMW - Anwar.

text.p: Malaysian Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim confirmed on Tuesday that Sapura Holdings Sdn Bhd has submitted a proposal to the government to buy a stake in UMW Holdings Bhd.
The national Bernama news agency quoted Anwar as saying no decision had been made on the proposal but that the government was looking into the matter.
UMW holds the franchise in Malaysia for the assembly and distribution of the Japanese Toyota vehicles.
On Monday, UMW's key shareholder -- the state investment fund Permodalan Nasional Bhd (PNB) -- said it had not received a proposal from Sapura, a telecommunications firm, for a buy-in.
Privately-held Sapura said last week it wanted to buy a stake in UMW, and market speculation indicated it proposed to buy a 32 percent equity.
Anwar said Sapura made the proposal directly to the government and not to PNB, which holds 45 percent of UMW equity.
